notes.title: The Adventure of Ted and the Lost Magic Crystals – BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
The Adventure of Ted and the Lost Magic Crystals  2.5D Platformer BIG UPDATE! Ver. 4.3
We’ve just released a major update packed with improvements and fresh content!

 What’s New in This Update:

 Fixed rope swing jump consistency – smoother and more reliable controls.

 Replaced audio soundFX & background music – enjoy a richer sound experience.

 Updated game graphics – sharper visuals and refreshed style.

 Added new obstacles in levels – more exciting challenges to overcome.

 Introduced new character dialogues – deeper story interaction and immersion.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy this new experience with Ted’s adventure!
